name: light-tunnel-bg

props.name: backgroundColor

props.name: text
props.description: Copy to reveal. Newlines start a new line; the block stays centred.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Plate behind the words.

props.name: colors
props.description: The two ends of the iridescent film the words condense out of.

props.name: silverColor
props.description: Colour the glyph interior settles to once the edge has passed.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of the sweep, in degrees. 0 sweeps left to right.

props.name: delay
props.description: Frame the reveal starts on.

props.name: duration
props.description: How many frames the sweep takes to cross the frame.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How far the two crossed sines bend the edge. 0 gives a straight wipe.

props.name: bandWidth
props.description: Width of the refracting band at the edge, in frame widths. Wider becomes a general blur; narrower reads as a clean chromatic rim.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How far the band displaces the glyph.

props.name: settle
props.description: How long after the edge the interior takes to settle to flat silver.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Type size in px, measured against the composition height.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Weight passed to the canvas rasteriser.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Worth pinning explicitly: the glyphs become a texture, so an unpinned stack resolves differently on a dev box and a render worker.

props.name: letterSpacing
props.description: Extra tracking in px.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Line height as a multiple of the type size.

name: dither-field-bg
description: Two-colour ordered-dither field quantised to a pixel grid

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: The unlit half of the two-tone field.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: The lit half. The field only ever holds these two colors.

props.name: shape
props.description: Pattern the dither is sampled from before the grid quantises it. simplex, warp, dots and wave fill the frame; ripple, swirl and sphere are bounded shapes.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Threshold matrix. Bayer sizes are ordered; random reads as film grain.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Size of one dither cell in pixels, 0.5–20. Larger reads more retro.

props.name: scale
props.description: Zoom on the underlying pattern, 0.01–4. Below 1 a bounded shape stops covering the frame.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplies how far the field travels per second.

name: warp-bands-bg
description: Colour bands folded through noise and a swirl

props.name: colors
props.description: Up to 10 colors, blended in order. Keep a dark one to hold the bands apart.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Base pattern the bands are laid over before distortion.

props.name: proportion
props.description: Where one color gives way to the next, 0–1.

props.name: softness
props.description: Edge hardness, 0 = hard band, 1 = full gradient. Changes its character most.

props.name: distortion
props.description: Noise distortion across the bands, 0–1.

props.name: swirl
props.description: Swirl strength, 0–1. This is what makes the bands read as marble.

props.name: swirlIterations
props.description: Layered swirl passes, 0–20. More passes, more folding.

props.name: patternScale
props.description: Zoom on the base pattern, 0–1.

props.name: scale
props.description: Overall zoom, 0.01–4.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation of the whole field in degrees.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplies how far the field travels per second.

name: grain-gradient-bg

props.description: Stage the shape sits on.

props.name: colors

props.name: shape
props.description: The form the gradient takes. Each is a different field, not a preset.

props.name: softness
props.description: Edge hardness between colors, 0 = posterised, 1 = smooth.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Distortion between the color bands, 0–1.

props.name: noise
props.description: Grain overlay, 0–1. Measured in real pixels, so it ignores scale.

props.name: scale
props.description: Overall zoom, 0.01–4.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplies how far the field travels per second.

name: ae-motion
description: After Effects mechanics as pure functions: graph-editor keyframe easing, loopIn/loopOut, deterministic wiggle and noise, repeater powers and parented transforms

name: bezier-path
description: Paths as cubic segments: parse any SVG d, measure, slice by arc length, resample and rebuild

name: curve-fit
description: Fit cubic béziers through a polyline (Schneider) with corner detection, so dense-point operators emit real curves

name: shape-ops

name: ae-import
description: Runtime for `remotion-ui import-ae`: After Effects shape, solid, null and precomp layers with parenting, time remap and lottie-web's stacking rules, drawn as SVG from ae-motion data

name: text-selectors
description: AE text range and wiggly selectors: per-unit selection with shapes, ease high/low, random order and combine modes

name: glyph-layout
description: Measured per-glyph layout with kerning-preserving prefixes, word-safe wrapping and fit-to-width

name: mograph
description: Cinema 4D MoGraph maths: cloner layouts, spherical/linear/noise falloff fields and stacked effectors

name: shape-layer

props.name: shapes
props.description: path (any SVG d), ellipse, rect, star or polygon. Merged into one geometry list.

props.name: operators
props.description: Operator stack run top to bottom: trim, repeater, offset, wiggle, zigzag, pucker-bloat, transform. Order changes the result.

props.name: width
props.description: Rendered width in px; shape units are px.

props.name: height
props.description: Rendered height in px.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where (0, 0) sits in the layer.

props.name: stroke
props.description: Stroke colour; null for no stroke.

props.name: strokeEnd
props.description: Colour the last repeater copy ramps to.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Static, keyframed or expression.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill colour.

props.name: fillEnd
props.description: Fill colour the last repeater copy ramps to.

props.name: lineCap
props.description: Stroke cap.

props.name: lineJoin
props.description: Stroke join.

props.name: glow
props.description: Bloom radius in px; 0 turns it off.

props.name: frame

name: text-animator

props.name: text
props.description: Copy. \n forces a line break; words wrap at maxWidth and never split.

props.name: animators
props.description: { properties, selectors?, basedOn? }. Properties: position, scale, rotation, skew, opacity, blur, tracking, fill, characterOffset.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Defaults to 84px at 1080 wide, scaled. Shrinks only if one word cannot fit.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: The render waits for this face before measuring.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Weight used for measuring and drawing.

props.name: color
props.description: Base fill before any animator recolours a glyph.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Multiple of the font size.

props.name: letterSpacing
props.description: Base tracking in em.

props.name: align
props.description: Line alignment; follows animated tracking.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Wrap width. Defaults to 84% of the composition width.

props.name: anchorGrouping
props.description: Pivot for scale and rotation.

props.name: waitForFont
props.description: Resolves when the face is loaded — pass waitUntilDone from loadFont. Without it, waits up to 1.5s for a loaded face of the primary family.

props.name: frame
props.description: Render this frame instead of the current one.

name: effector-field
description: Cinema 4D MoGraph cloner and effectors: clone any element into a grid, radial or linear arrangement and let animatable spherical, linear or noise falloff fields drive each clone

props.name: layout
props.description: grid, honeycomb, radial (count, radius, sweep, align) or linear (count, step, rotationStep, scaleStep).

props.name: effectors
props.description: { fields?, position [x,y,z], scale, rotation [x,y,z], opacity, color, strength }, run in order.

props.name: width
props.description: Stage width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

props.name: cloneSize
props.description: Size of each clone's box.

props.name: color
props.description: Clone colour before tints; children can use currentColor.

props.name: children
props.description: Element to clone, painted in currentColor. Defaults to a rounded tile.

props.name: renderClone
props.description: Per-clone renderer; receives weight, index, u/v and the tinted colour.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Camera distance for z moves and x/y rotation.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Tilts the cloner plane away from the camera, degrees.

props.name: renderer
props.description: dom clones any React child; canvas draws cloneShape with the same camera, for thousands of clones.

props.name: cloneShape
props.description: Canvas renderer only: the drawn shape.

props.name: glow
props.description: Canvas renderer only: bloom radius in px at full field weight.

props.name: frame
props.description: Render this frame instead of the current one.

name: rig
description: Rig maths: law-of-cosines two-bone IK with bend, stretch and soft IK (no knee pop at full reach), and constant-length rubber-hose arcs

name: pen-plot
description: Pen-plotter motion planning: SVG strokes to a pen position per frame, with cosine-ramped speed, full stops in cusps, lifts, and anticipating pen-up moves

name: follow
description: Overlapping action: a chain of damped springs following a leader track, simulated deterministically from frame 0 and memoised

name: slit-geometry
description: Slit-scan strips (bands at any angle or radial rings) with per-strip delays grouped into a bounded number of child renders

name: slit-scan
description: Slit-scan time displacement: each strip of any child — rows, columns, rings or a gradient map — shows that child at a different moment, deterministically

props.name: children
props.description: Anything time-based: footage, a scene, another motion component.

props.name: width
props.description: Frame width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Frame height in px.

props.name: mode
props.description: Straight strips at an angle, or rings around a centre.

props.name: strips
props.description: Number of strips. Free — levels sets the cost.

props.name: angle
props.description: Bands: direction the delay grows along, degrees.

props.name: center
props.description: Radial: centre as shares of the frame.

props.name: maxDelay
props.description: Delay of the last strip, in frames (fractional ok).

props.name: levels
props.description: Distinct delays = renders of the child per frame.

props.name: curve
props.description: Maps strip position 0–1 to delay share 0–1. Default linear.

props.name: loopFrames
props.description: Wrap sampled frames into a loop, so strips look back into the previous cycle.

props.name: frame
props.description: Render this frame instead of the current one.

usage:
import { SlitScan } from "@/remotion/primitives/slit-scan";

<SlitScan mode="radial" strips={120} levels={60} maxDelay={30} loopFrames={150}>
  <MyLoopingScene />
</SlitScan>

name: ik-rig
description: A lit, shadowed two-bone IK arm that reaches for any target or plots SVG strokes with a pen, laying ink exactly where the solved hand is; soft IK, fixed bend, animatable base

props.name: base
props.description: Shoulder position. Animate it to mount the arm on a rail, a vehicle or a body.

props.name: lengths
props.description: Upper arm and forearm length, px.

props.name: target
props.description: What the hand reaches for: static, keyframed or an expression. Ignored when plot is set.

props.name: plot
props.description: { d, speed?, travelSpeed?, ramp?, cornerAngle?, liftFrames?, minTravelFrames?, overshoot?, startFrame?, home?, park? } — strokes the hand draws with a pen. Each

props.name: bend
props.description: Side the elbow folds to. Fixed for the shot, so the elbow never flips.

props.name: softness
props.description: Soft IK: share of the reach over which the arm eases into full extension instead of popping straight.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Upper-arm width, px; the rest of the arm is proportioned from it.

props.name: armColor
props.description: Anodised body colour; lit and shaded per frame from lightAngle.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Status light on the pen head; bright while the pen is down.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: Ink and the hot glow at the nib.

props.name: inkWidth
props.description: Ink stroke width, px.

props.name: glow
props.description: Bloom on the ink, 0–1. 0 draws flat ink.

props.name: lightAngle
props.description: Direction the key light comes from, degrees in screen space (-90 = from above).

props.name: shadow
props.description: Cast-shadow opacity. Shadow offset grows with each part's height and with pen lift.

props.name: cable
props.description: Slack service cable from base to elbow (a constant-length rubber hose).

props.name: renderArm
props.description: Replaces the built-in arm with your own SVG, drawn from the solved pose.

props.name: renderUnder
props.description: SVG under the ink — paper, beds, rails.

props.name: renderOver
props.description: SVG over everything.

name: track-matte
description: After Effects track mattes: reveal any child through any other with alpha, inverted alpha, luma or inverted luma

props.name: mode
props.description: How the matte decides visibility.

props.name: matte
props.description: SVG content in the width × height space: shapes, <text>, <image>, a nested <svg>, or <MatteVideo>.

props.name: children
props.description: What is revealed — any HTML.

props.name: width
props.description: Matte and content width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Matte and content height in px.

usage:
import { MatteVideo, TrackMatte } from "@/remotion/primitives/track-matte";

<TrackMatte mode="alpha" matte={<text x={480} y={330} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={220} fill="white">WORD</text>}>
  <OffthreadVideo src={staticFile("clip.mp4")} />
</TrackMatte>

// Footage as the matte:
<TrackMatte mode="luma" matte={<MatteVideo src={staticFile("clip.mp4")} />}>
  <Gradient />
</TrackMatte>

name: follow-through
description: Overlapping action along a chain: every element follows one leader track with its own delay, drag, overshoot and settle

props.name: leader
props.description: The leader's path: keyframe track, expression or fixed point.

props.name: links
props.description: Elements after the leader.

props.name: frequency
props.description: Spring frequency in Hz; higher is tighter.

props.name: damping
props.description: 1 settles without overshoot; lower overshoots and rings.

props.name: delay
props.description: Frames each link looks back at the one ahead.

props.name: falloff
props.description: Per-link frequency multiplier; below 1 the tail loosens.

props.name: preroll
props.description: Simulate this many frames early so a looping leader starts in steady motion.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Draws one link; positioned and optionally rotated for you.

props.name: renderSpine
props.description: Draws the chain's spine as SVG — ropes, tails, ribbons.

props.name: orient
props.description: Rotate each link to face the one ahead.

props.name: width
props.description: Stage width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height in px.

props.name: frame
props.description: Render this frame instead of the current one.
